description: I invite enthusiasts for exploration and self-improvement.
summary: We are a team of beginner developers taking our first steps into the world of programming. We created a browser-based game focused on Mars exploration, using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Our project introduces players to the challenges of exploring another planet through interactive gameplay. Although this is our first major development challenge, we wanted to combine creativity, teamwork, and technology to bring our idea to life. This project is an important first step in our journey as developers and an opportunity to learn, experiment, and build something meaningful together.
details: As a team, we developed an interactive browser game using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. This is our first comprehensive project and our first major challenge on our journey into programming. During development, we created the game mechanics, design, and user interaction logic using Visual Studio Code and GitHub. Our main priorities were engaging gameplay, user-friendly controls, and accessibility without requiring additional software installation. Our goal is to gain practical experience in teamwork and software development, improve our programming skills, and build a foundation for more complex projects in the future.
